footnote_text: Represents shares of common stock purchased from the issuer in a private transaction by Inderjit Mangat, the reporting person's spouse, who is the sole officer and a director of Ima Tech, for an aggregate purchase price of $300,000, or $0.005 per share. The transaction was approved by the Board of Directors of Ima Tech on September 18, 2026, and is exempt from Section 16(b) pursuant to Rule 16b-3(d). Following this transaction, Ms. Mangat holds 61,500,000 shares of common stock. Mr. Janda disclaims beneficial ownership of these shares except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein, and the filing of this statement shall not be deemed an admission that Mr. Janda is the beneficial owner of such shares for purposes of Section 16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 or for any other purpose.
